QuestInfo.name: [Commerci Republic] Barrier to the Canals
QuestInfo.0: You were curious to know where the Barrier in the canals led. With that in mind, you spoke with Gilberto about the matter.
QuestInfo.1:
Gilberto showed a great deal of interest in the Barrier, but told you that he does not have enough people to investigate. You decided to go with Leon as a favor to Gilberto. Leon promised to follow if you would go and investigate, and Gilberto wanted you to defeat any monsters found within the barrier. He thought 50 of each type would be enough.

There seemed to be many Delfinos in the barrier. Eliminating some helped you and Leon investigate matters.

0.msg: You said you discovered a new barrier?

2.msg: This barrier you found sounds intriguing, but we don't have enough people to deal with it. All of our forces are on guard duty.

3.msg: Since you're already helping me out, do you want to do me one more favor? Can you investigate the barrier?

yes.0:
Investigate the barrier!
Hunt any monsters you find and search for any clues! 50 of each kind should do.

I'll send Leon with you as backup.
yes.1: I suggest you go with a party. It might be dangerous!

no.0: Talk to me when you want to help.

0.msg: Did you have a look at the monsters?

1.msg: Yeah! But something's off... There are too many Delfinos.

2.msg: I thought that was strange too...

yes.0: The Delfino Hideout must be around here somewhere...
yes.1: I should investigate further. Talk to me if you remember anything else!

npc.0: Go to the canal. Leon will follow you.

mob.0: Have you hunted each kind of monster inside the new barrier?
